app.name: TM Sync
app.short_description: Sync TM:CE save, then boot Slippi
app.long_description:
Pulls the newest GTME.raw from Wii Memcard Manager on your Mac over Wi-Fi (only when it changed), writes it to the SD card, then boots Slippi Nintendont straight into your last game.
A: launch now. HOME/START: back to the Homebrew Channel. Hold B at startup to skip the sync.
